title: Preparation of aggregate-free α -synuclein  for _in vitro_ aggregation study
protocol: Express α-Syn in E.Coli BL21 (D3 strain) and purify according to established protocol.
Lyophilize the purified protein and store at -20°C until further use.
Suspend 10 mg of solid lyophilized protein in 500 µl of 20 mM Gly-NaOH buffer, pH 7.4, containing 0.01% sodium azide.
Add a few µl of 2M NaOH solution to the suspension to achieve a clear α-Syn solution with a pH greater than 9.5.
Gradually reduce the pH of the resulting solution to 7.4 by adding a few µl of 2N HCl and confirm the final pH using a micro pH meter.
Centrifuge the solution at 13000 xg for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant and transfer 250 µl into a pre-washed 10 kDa mini dialysis unit.
Dialyze against 20 mM Gly-NaOH buffer, pH 7.4, containing 0.01% sodium azide for 10 hours at 4°C to remove salt and fragmented proteins/peptides.
Remove the solution after 10 hours of dialysis and transfer into a 100 kDa cut-off filter.
Wash the cut-off filter three times with buffer by centrifuging at 6000 x g for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge the solution at 10000 x g for 30 minutes at 4°C to isolate low molecular weight α-Syn.
Transfer the flow-through containing LMW α-Syn to a low binding tube.
Place the tubes into an Echo Thermo model RT11 rotating mixer (Torrey Pines Scientific, USA).
Incubate the tubes in a 37°C incubator.
Rotate the tube containing α-Syn solution at 50 rpm to initiate aggregation.
Remove aliquots of sample from the tubes at regular time intervals for analysis.
Monitor aggregation kinetics with ThT fluorescence measurement at regular intervals (4-6 h).
Dilute 3.3 μl of 300 μM protein solution to 200 μl to achieve a final concentration of 5 μM α-Syn.
Add 2 μl of 1 mM ThT prepared in 20 mM Tris HCl buffer (pH 8) to the diluted α-Syn solution.
Measure ThT fluorescence by exciting at 450 nm.
Acquire emission spectra in the range of 465 nm to 500 nm with a slit width of 5 nm.
Plot fluorescence intensity at 480 nm against incubation time (hours).
Dilute 7.5 µl of 300 μM incubated protein solution to 150 µl in 20 mM Gly-NaOH, pH 7.4 with 0.01% sodium azide.
Place the diluted solution into a 0.1 cm path-length quartz cell.
Acquire CD spectra using a JASCO-810 instrument at 25°C.
Record spectra over the wavelength range of 200-260 nm.
Process raw data by smoothing and subtracting buffer spectra according to manufacturer’s instructions.
